buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of DY.FA&CAO/C/JHANSI payable at JHANSI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C DY.FA&CAO/C/JHANSI . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of DY.FA&CAO/C/JHANSI payable at JHANSI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to

ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Service & Support In the event where the distance travelled exceeds the monthly usage variant, amount will be paid for additional Kms as per schedule. Similarly, the unused Kms in a particular month as against the minimum guaranteed usage variant will be carried forward to the next month and additional Km if any in the next month shall be adjusted against this. However, the payment for the selected usage variant in a month will be paid every month.” Further, the unused Kms in a particular month shall not be carried forward or adjusted beyond 6 months 7. Other Conditions: (1) The bidders are required to attach only those documents under the past performance/experience crite ria in which the firm has Supplied/Executed the same or similar service given in the bid in any Central /Stat e Government Department/PSUs/Autonomous bodies under any Govt Dept.In this regard only the acceptan ce/completion Certificate of Service issued by respective authority of concerned Government Department/ PSUs or Service Delivery Acceptance Certificate issued by Consignee of Government Department/PSUs will only be considered valid. Completed service contract includes on-going service contract subject to payme nt of bills amounting to at least required amount of the advertised value of the bid. The document attachin g only Purchase Order/GeM Contract copy will not be considered as experience certificate. (2) Service Provider to ensure the compliance of legal requirement such as valid Registration Certificate of Vehicle and Commercial Permit during the execution of service i.e. at the time of providing service to the c onsignee. (3) Since service of vehicle hiring is required for 24 Hours in a day hence successful bidder will have to pla n accordingly to ensure uninterrupted service. (4) This service is for Hiring of vehicle related to public safety, health, critical security operations and equi pment, hence past experience/performance and financial turnover of all firms are necessary to participate in the bid. (5) All the bidder please note that please quote their rates with all taxes and duties as No any additional ta xes like toll, octroi, parking charges etc. will be paid by Railway Administration. (6) The tenderer shall indemnify the Railway against any or all claims, which may arise under the Motor Ve hicles ACT or Workman's compensation Act or any other act or Stature having bearing over the services an d for engagement of workmen, directly or indirectly for performance of work under the contract. (7)This vehicle hiring service contract executing authority will be office of (DY.CE/C/GWL/HQ/NCR) and thei r authorized persons under their jurisdiction. The payment will be done quarterly basis on submission of bi lls by contractor. .
